title: Python's F-String for String Interpolation and Formatting
description: Python f-strings give you a readable, concise way to interpolate and format strings, and they beat .format() and the % operator on speed.
summary: Python f-strings offer a concise and efficient way to interpolate variables, objects , and expressions directly into strings. By prefixing a string with f or F , you can embed expressions within curly braces ( {} ), which are evaluated at runtime .
